3. Adverse Event Narrative
A 59-year-old male received Dose 2 of mRNA-1273 (Spikevax) on 16 October 2025. Approximately 13 day(s) following vaccination, the patient developed symptoms consistent with Anaphylaxis. The patient sought medical attention and was hospitalized for observation. The outcome was recovered with sequelae. The reporter cannot exclude a relationship with mRNA-1273 vaccination.
